description:
Implement the sketch's Lean obligation for $q$-cyclotomic seed closure: the derived set is the smallest superset of the seed closed under multiplication by $q$ modulo $n$.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The closure lemmas are proven and `lake build` passes with no new untracked assumptions.
- [hard] REQ-02: The obligation binds to the closure production path exactly as the approved sketch assigns.
title: Lean proofs: q-cyclotomic seed closure
